# Monument Escrow, Inc.

> Locally owned escrow company with offices in Modesto and Fresno, California. Meet our escrow officers, open an escrow, and find our office hours and locations.

Locally owned in Modesto, California. We guide buyers, sellers and lenders through every step of the closing, with clear answers and a real person to call.

## Offices
- Modesto Office: 515 Lyell Drive, Suite 102, Modesto, CA 95356. Phone 209-526-5356. Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm. Closed weekends.
- Fresno Office: 7395 N. Palm Bluffs Ave., Suite 104, Fresno, CA 93711. Phone 559-354-2760. Hours: Monday to Friday, 9:00 am to 5:00 pm. Closed weekends.

## Services
- Residential Resale
- Refinance
- Private Financing
- 1031 Exchange
- Short Sales
- Probate Sales
- Seller Carry Back
- All Inclusive Trust Deeds
